text:
```yaml
name: CI Rebundle Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [24]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test
```
